scope: 2026-01-01 through 2026-03-29 DEV evaluation, non-newcomer races only; no VALIDATION/OOS access

redundancy.decision: KEEP_ALL_SIX_FOR_ARCHITECTURE_SCOPE; no feature is removed for multicollinearity. Prior outcome-fitted coefficient magnitude is not used as a feature-selection rule.

history_availability.finding: All five last-start-dependent fields are structurally unavailable when horse_prior_starts=0.

design_decision.zero_prior_starter_inside_non_newcomer_r: do not fabricate historical context; residual correction for that horse is fixed to zero so DIRECT_MARKET remains its own baseline before race normalization
design_decision.residual_fit_rows: future executable prereg should fit residual coefficients only where required history context exists, while evaluation population remains complete
design_decision.why: structural data-availability rule fixed before any new DEV trial, not a performance-selected subgroup rule

gate_dependency: Race-time Snapshot Gate v5 real Windows/JV-Link forward provenance PASS remains required before a new executable DEV trial
